\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

findings.claim_quote: `Request::addBuffer`는 `FrameBuffer`를 요청에 추가하면서, 인자 stream으로 지정한 그 버퍼가 속한 스트림에 버퍼를 연결하는 API입니다. 요청은 스트림마다 버퍼를 하나만 담을 수 있으므로, 같은 스트림에 이미 버퍼가 있거나 버퍼가 아직 fence를 참조하고 있으면 -EEXIST를 반환합니다. 버퍼가 유효한 `Stream`을 참조하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

\fn CameraConfiguration::validate()
 * \brief Validate and possibly adjust the camera configuration
 *
 * This function adjusts the camera configuration to the closest valid
 * configuration and returns the validation status.
 *
 * \todo Define exactly when to return each status code. Should stream
 * parameters set to 0 by the caller be adjusted without returning Adjusted ?
 * This would potentially be useful for applications but would get in the way
 * in Camera::configure(). Do we need an extra status code to signal this ?
 *
 * \todo Handle validation of buffers count when refactoring the buffers API.
 *
 * \return A CameraConfiguration::Status value that describes the validation
 * status.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Invalid The configuration is invalid and can't
 * be adjusted. This may only occur in extreme cases such as when the
 * configuration is empty.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Adjusted The configuration has been adjusted
 * and is now valid. Parameters may have changed for any stream, and stream
 * configurations may have been removed. The caller shall check the
 * configuration carefully.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Valid The configuration was already valid and
 * hasn't been adjusted.
 */

/**
 * \brief Retrieve a reference to a stream configuration

\retval CameraConfiguration::Adjusted The configuration has been adjusted
 * and is now valid. Parameters may have changed for any stream, and stream
 * configurations may have been removed. The caller shall check the
 * configuration carefully.

findings.claim_quote: CameraConfiguration::validate()의 Adjusted는 구성이 유효하도록 조정된 상태이며, 임의의 스트림에서 파라미터가 변경되거나 스트림 구성이 삭제될 수 있습니다. Adjusted를 받은 호출자는 구성을 주의 깊게 확인해야 합니다. 조사할 때 Camera::configure()에서 config->validate()의 결과가 CameraConfiguration::Valid와 다른지와, 다른 경우 반환하는 오류 코드 -EINVAL을 함께 기록합니다.

findings.scope: Validation status, caller obligation, and the visible Camera::configure branch.

sources.source_quote:
\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

findings.claim_quote: Request::addBuffer는 FrameBuffer를 요청에 추가하면서, 인자 stream으로 지정한 그 버퍼가 속한 스트림에 버퍼를 연결하는 API입니다. 요청은 스트림마다 버퍼를 하나만 담을 수 있으므로, 같은 스트림에 이미 버퍼가 있거나 버퍼가 아직 fence를 참조하고 있으면 -EEXIST를 반환합니다. 버퍼가 유효한 Stream을 참조하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

request-diagnosis.md/configuration-failu.text: 기존 `Camera::Private::isAccessAllowed` 호출의 조사에서는 먼저 `allowDisconnected`가 거짓이고 `disconnected_`가 참일 때 `-ENODEV`를 반환하는 선행 분기를 구분합니다. 그 밖에는 `currentState`와 `low`, `high`의 범위 비교 및 범위 안의 `0` 반환을 살펴보고, 범위 밖에서는 `ASSERT`, 오류 로그, `-EACCES` 반환의 코드 위치를 순서대로 확인합니다.
조사할 때 `Camera::configure()`에서 `config->validate()`의 결과가 `CameraConfiguration::Valid`와 다른지와, 다른 경우 반환하는 오류 코드 `-EINVAL`을 함께 기록합니다.

조사할 때 `Camera::configure()`에서 접근 검사와 설정 검증을 통과한 뒤 `PipelineHandler::configure`의 반환값이 0인 경우, 각 `cfg.stream()`의 결과인 `stream`과 null 검사 결과를 관찰합니다. `stream`이 null이면 Fatal 로그 `Pipeline handler failed to update stream configuration`과 `activeStreams_.clear()` 다음의 `-EINVAL` 반환 경로를 확인합니다.

request-diagnosis.md/submission-checks/3.text: 모든 앞선 검사를 통과하면 patchControlList로 AeEnable을 전처리한 뒤 `PipelineHandler::queueRequest`를 ConnectionTypeQueued로 예약하고 0을 반환합니다.

catalog/f885f5295f97fed3/en.text: When investigating, inside Camera::configure, observe the return value ret of the existing isAccessAllowed call that passes Private::CameraAcquired and Private::CameraConfigured as arguments. If ret < 0, record the failure branch where Camera::configure returns the same ret. When investigating the existing Camera::Private::isAccessAllowed call, first distinguish the earlier branch that returns -ENODEV when allowDisconnected is false and disconnected_ is true. Otherwise, review the range comparison of currentState with low and high, and the return of 0 within the range; outside the range, check in order the code locations of ASSERT, the error log, and the return of -EACCES.

catalog/948d857e662479be.text: CameraConfiguration::validate()의 Adjusted는 구성이 유효하도록 조정된 상태이며, 임의의 스트림에서 파라미터가 변경되거나 스트림 구성이 삭제될 수 있습니다. Adjusted를 받은 호출자는 구성을 주의 깊게 확인해야 합니다. 조사할 때 Camera::configure()에서 config->validate()의 결과가 CameraConfiguration::Valid와 다른지와, 다른 경우 반환하는 오류 코드 -EINVAL을 함께 기록합니다.

catalog/948d857e662479be/en.text: The Adjusted status of CameraConfiguration::validate() means the configuration has been adjusted to be valid, and parameters may change for any stream or stream configurations may be removed. The caller that receives Adjusted must check the configuration carefully. When investigating, the investigator records whether the result of config->validate() in Camera::configure() differs from CameraConfiguration::Valid, and, when they differ, also records the error code -EINVAL that is returned.

catalog/a9b62915a8c7bbbe.text: 조사할 때 Camera::configure()에서 접근 검사와 설정 검증을 통과한 뒤 PipelineHandler::configure의 반환값이 0인 경우, 각 cfg.stream()의 결과인 stream과 null 검사 결과를 관찰합니다. stream이 null이면 Fatal 로그 Pipeline handler failed to update stream configuration과 activeStreams_.clear() 다음의 -EINVAL 반환 경로를 확인합니다.

catalog/a9b62915a8c7bbbe/en.text: When investigating, in Camera::configure(), after passing the access check and configuration validation, and when the return value of PipelineHandler::configure is 0, observe the result stream of each cfg.stream() and the null check result. If stream is null, check the Fatal log Pipeline handler failed to update stream configuration and the -EINVAL return path after activeStreams_.clear().

catalog/e247416141f228f2.text: queueRequest는 먼저 isAccessAllowed(CameraRunning)를 호출하며, 연결이 해제된 경우 -ENODEV를, 연결이 해제되지 않았지만 Running 상태가 아닌 경우 -EACCES를 반환합니다. 반환값이 음수이면 요청 내용을 검사하기 전에 그 값을 그대로 반환합니다.

catalog/e247416141f228f2/en.text: queueRequest first calls isAccessAllowed(CameraRunning). If the camera has been disconnected, queueRequest returns -ENODEV; if it has not been disconnected but is not in the Running state, queueRequest returns -EACCES. If the return value is negative, queueRequest returns that value unchanged before checking the request contents.

catalog/891b869f3c5a6519.text: 접근 검사를 통과한 뒤 요청을 생성한 카메라가 현재 카메라와 다르면 -EXDEV를 반환합니다. 다음으로 요청 상태가 RequestPending이 아니면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 이어서 controls().infoMap()을 카메라의 controls() 주소와 비교하여 controls 목록을 다른 목록으로 덮어쓰지 못하게 검사하며, 일치하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

catalog/891b869f3c5a6519/en.text: After the access check passes, if the camera that created the request differs from the current camera, return -EXDEV. Next, if the request status is not RequestPending, return -EINVAL. Then, compare controls().infoMap() with the camera's controls() address to check that the controls list cannot be overwritten with another list, and if they do not match, return -EINVAL.

catalog/c13d86693bf4590e.text: 버퍼 맵이 비어 있으면 해당 검사에서 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 그다음 각 버퍼의 스트림을 검사하여 activeStreams_에 없는 스트림이 있으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 모든 앞선 검사를 통과하면 patchControlList로 AeEnable을 전처리한 뒤 PipelineHandler::queueRequest를 ConnectionTypeQueued로 예약하고 0을 반환합니다.

catalog/c13d86693bf4590e/en.text: If the buffer map is empty, Camera::queueRequest returns -EINVAL at that check. Then, if any stream of each buffer is not in activeStreams_, Camera::queueRequest returns -EINVAL. If all preceding checks pass, Camera::queueRequest preprocesses AeEnable with patchControlList, schedules PipelineHandler::queueRequest with ConnectionTypeQueued, and returns 0.

catalog/25109902de96d8bb.text: 주석은 요청을 처리할 버퍼 메모리가 없을 때 -ENOMEM을 반환한다고 설명합니다. 구현에는 -ENOMEM을 직접 반환하는 분기가 없습니다.

catalog/25109902de96d8bb/en.text: The comment explains that -ENOMEM is returned when no buffer memory is available to handle the request. The implementation has no branch that directly returns -ENOMEM.

catalog/1a5e9bf19b97e730.text: Request::addBuffer는 FrameBuffer를 요청에 추가하면서, 인자 stream으로 지정한 그 버퍼가 속한 스트림에 버퍼를 연결하는 API입니다. 요청은 스트림마다 버퍼를 하나만 담을 수 있으므로, 같은 스트림에 이미 버퍼가 있거나 버퍼가 아직 fence를 참조하고 있으면 -EEXIST를 반환합니다. 버퍼가 유효한 Stream을 참조하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

catalog/1a5e9bf19b97e730/en.text: Request::addBuffer is an API that adds FrameBuffer to the request and connects the buffer to the stream to which the buffer belongs, as specified by the stream argument. Because a request can hold only one buffer per stream, -EEXIST is returned if the same stream already has a buffer or if the buffer still references a fence. -EINVAL is returned if the buffer does not reference a valid Stream.

catalog/ddb293231666c195.text: Request::addBuffer()는 먼저 !stream 조건을 확인하고, 참이면 "Invalid stream reference" 오류 로그를 남긴 뒤 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 다음으로 buffer->_d()->fence()가 남아 있으면 -EEXIST를 반환하므로, fence가 남아 있는 버퍼는 이 단계에서 등록되지 않습니다. 마지막으로 bufferMap_.try_emplace(stream, buffer)의 inserted가 false이면, 로그 "FrameBuffer already set for stream"과 함께 -EEXIST를 반환합니다.

catalog/ddb293231666c195/en.text: Request::addBuffer() first checks whether !stream is true. If it is, the error "Invalid stream reference" is logged, and -EINVAL is returned. Next, if buffer->_d()->fence() still exists, -EEXIST is returned, so a buffer that still has a fence is not registered at this stage. Finally, if inserted of bufferMap_.try_emplace(stream, buffer) is false, the log "FrameBuffer already set for stream" is written, and -EEXIST is returned.

catalog/7642a4c733b45403.text: Camera::queueRequest()는 request->_d()->camera()가 this와 다르면, 즉 요청을 만든 카메라가 현재 카메라가 아니면 "Request was not created by this camera" 오류를 기록하고 -EXDEV를 반환합니다. Camera::queueRequest는 request->status()가 Request::RequestPending과 일치하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 request->controls().infoMap()과 &controls()를 !=로 비교하여 두 값이 다르면 LOG(Camera, Error)로 "Overwriting Request::controls() is not allowed"를 기록하고 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

catalog/7642a4c733b45403/en.text: If request->_d()->camera() differs from this, meaning the camera that created the request is not the current camera, Camera::queueRequest() logs the error "Request was not created by this camera" and returns -EXDEV. When request->status() does not match Request::RequestPending, Camera::queueRequest returns -EINVAL. Camera::queueRequest() compares request->controls().infoMap() with &controls() using !=, and when the two values differ, the message "Overwriting Request::controls() is not allowed" is recorded through LOG(Camera, Error), and the returned value is -EINVAL.

catalog/9d141e4b7ca20344.text: Camera::queueRequest()는 request->buffers()가 비어 있으면, 즉 empty()가 참이면 Request contains no buffers 오류를 기록하고 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 request->buffers()의 각 stream이 d->activeStreams_에 없으면(find가 end()를 반환하면) -EINVAL을 반환합니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 요청 검사를 마친 뒤 ConnectionTypeQueued를 지정해 invokeMethod로 PipelineHandler::queueRequest를 호출하고, 그 호출 뒤에 0을 반환합니다. 이 0은 invokeMethod 호출 뒤의 반환값이며, 요청 완료는 카메라가 requestCompleted 신호로 별도로 알립니다.

catalog/9d141e4b7ca20344/en.text: When request->buffers() is empty, that is, when empty() is true, Camera::queueRequest() logs the error "Request contains no buffers" and returns -EINVAL. If any stream in request->buffers() is absent from d->activeStreams_ (that is, if find returns end()), Camera::queueRequest() returns -EINVAL. After completing the request checks, Camera::queueRequest() specifies ConnectionTypeQueued, calls PipelineHandler::queueRequest through invokeMethod, and returns 0 after that call. This 0 is the return value after the invokeMethod call, and the camera separately notifies request completion through the requestCompleted signal.

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)
{
	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	camera->bufferCompleted.emit(request, buffer);
	return request->_d()->completeBuffer(buffer);
}
